title: Accessibility
heading: Accessibility statement
lead: This website is meant to be usable by everyone. The benchmark is the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA.

status.heading: Conformance status
status.text: The website is developed with the aim of meeting these requirements. This includes keyboard operation, support for screen readers and sufficient contrast in the light and the dark color scheme.
